justification: The fixed 2.4.0 was published 2026-10-22, inside the 7-day minimumReleaseAge floor until 2026-10-29; reached only through record-node's express API, which the bundled node binds to 127.0.0.1 (src/main/bundled/node-manager.ts), so only local callers can send it a body. Upgrade when the floor clears.

The fixed 44.9.1 was published 2026-10-20, inside the 7-day minimumReleaseAge floor until 2026-10-27; the renderer loads only the bundled page and the loopback node, and refuses every navigation, redirect and window.open (src/main/window.ts), so Chromium makes no TLS connection that trusts the revoked intermediates. Upgraded with body-parser and multer on 2026-10-29.
No fixed release exists; reached only through electron-builder's @electron/get (got, cacheable-request), which downloads Electron and build tools while packaging, never in the shipped app.

The fixed 2.5.0 was published 2026-10-22, inside the 7-day minimumReleaseAge floor until 2026-10-29; record-node pins multer exactly, so the fix is a record-node pin bump and a record-app re-pin. Reached only through the node's upload routes on the loopback-bound bundled node.
No fixed release exists; reached only through @helia/libp2p's autoTLS (acme-client), which record-node imports but never configures, so no RSA signature is verified with it.
